slides.sub: Don't pick your go-to pizza place in East Hanover until you've tried these 3.

slides.title: Lazio's Pizzeria
slides.body: The easy weeknight call. Cheese pizza is a top seller, and the grandma pie is a thin, hand-stretched pan pie with San Marzano tomatoes.
slides.source: Slice, Lazio's Pizzeria & Family Restaurant page (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: Avellino Wood Fired Brick Oven
slides.body: Same road, different crust. Square focaccia, grandma pies and brick oven wings with long hots.
slides.source: Slice, Avellino Wood Fired Brick Oven page (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: The Godfather of East Hanover
slides.body: The Route 10 stop. The Margherita pizza is one of its house favorites, with wings and paninis if not everyone wants a slice.
slides.source: Slice, The Godfather of East Hanover page (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: One pizza night in East Hanover
slides.tip: Tour on a weeknight. Then drive Ridgedale Ave and Route 10 at rush hour before you offer.
